summary: Completed comprehensive testing of d+p | compugrafic landing page. Both backend APIs and frontend functionality working well with minor issues identified.

minor_bugs.issue: Email validation not working - accepts invalid email formats
minor_bugs.impact: Invalid emails can be submitted through contact form
minor_bugs.details: Backend uses 'email: str' instead of 'EmailStr' in ContactMessageCreate model

ui_bugs.issue: D+P toggle button outside viewport on mobile, preventing clicks

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section and 4 service cards
Navigation links (SERVICIOS, NOSOTROS, CONTACTO) scroll to sections
D+P toggle switches to D+P section on desktop
D+P section displays with process steps and deliverables
Contact form validation for required fields (nombre, email, mensaje)
Contact form submission to POST /api/contact works
Footer toggle buttons switch between sections
Responsive design adapts to mobile viewport
Form submissions saved to MongoDB with correct section data
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix email validation in backend ContactMessageCreate model by using EmailStr instead of str. Fix mobile navigation positioning for D+P toggle button.
